name: Crabtree Auto
old_description: Welcome to Crabtree Auto. We are your premier shop for new & used car parts, auto salvage, & used car part sales. Our company has over 70 years of experience in the auto salvage industry and has served individuals and commercial clients all across Utah. Crabtree Auto buys damaged vehicles that are 10 years old and newer, and we sell the undamaged parts to body shops, individuals and more.
about:
Crabtree Auto operates from Riverdale, Utah, just outside Ogden. The business traces its roots to the post‑World War II era when the Crabtree brothers opened a body shop in Logan, Utah, and began selling parts from their own vehicles. In 1947 the operation relocated to Riverdale, where Dahl Crabtree became sole owner and later passed the company to his sons, Miles and Colin. Today the third generation of the family directs the business, which bills itself as the oldest in the city.

The company runs a full‑service auto salvage yard, purchasing damaged vehicles ten model years old or newer and dismantling them for reusable components. Its inventory spans transmissions, engines, bumpers, fenders, lighting, glass, mirrors, dashboards, tires, wheels, grilles, hoods, trunk lids, axles, brake drums and doors. All parts are pre‑dismantled, cleaned, tested and shelved for immediate pickup or delivery. Facility size and headcount are not disclosed.

Customers include body shops, insurance companies, fellow salvage yards and individual vehicle owners across northern Utah. The yard serves both commercial and retail buyers, offering a ready supply of recycled OEM parts for collision repair and maintenance.

Crabtree Auto distinguishes itself through membership in the Automotive Recyclers Association (ARA) and as a founding member of the United Recyclers Group (URG), adhering to URG quality standards for premium recycled parts. Its long‑standing slogan — “CLEAN – ORGANIZED – QUICK SERVICE” — reflects an emphasis on facility upkeep and fast turnaround.
